Based on the visual characteristics of the time series, the most prominent anomaly is a distinct shift in the baseline level (mean) of the data.

1.  **Initial State:** From index 0 to approximately 580, the data fluctuates around a mean value of roughly 2-3 mm.
2.  **Anomalous Shift:** Starting around index 600, there is a clear step-change where the data jumps up and begins fluctuating around a much higher mean value of roughly 9-10 mm. This high-level regime continues until the end of the series.

Therefore, the range from approximately 600 to the end of the plot represents an anomalous period compared to the rest of the dataset.

[[600, 740]]
